parole.significato: charcuterie, processed and cured meats (bacon, chorizo, corned beef, salami, sausage, etc)
parole.testo: From άλλαντα (állanta) + -ικός (-ikós), in which άλλαντα (állanta) is inherited from Ancient Greek ἀλλᾶντες (allântes, “sausages”), the plural of ἀλλᾶς (allâs), which is perhaps from dialectal *αλλᾱϝεντ- (*allāwent-, “sausage seasoned with garlic”), from Proto-Italic *allā- (“garlic”), whence Latin
